chunks: We shall admit those who believe and do the right to empyreal gardens with rivers rippling by, where they will abide for ever. How excellent the guerdon of those who toil,
ai.seo_question: What is the specific reward promised to believers who perform righteous deeds in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inseparable link between faith (Iman) and righteous action (Amal al-Salih), reflecting the principle that true belief manifests in practical devotion. The 'chambers' (Ghuraf) are interpreted as elevated spiritual stations attained through consistent effort, emphasizing that divine reward is proportional to the quality of one's deeds. This aligns with the Shia emphasis on the balance between knowledge and action in achieving nearness to God.
